summary: Full backend + frontend testing for SIM Klinik Bidan completed. All 17 pytest backend tests pass (auth, patients, drugs seeding+CRUD, visits with invoice/stock, billing/pay flow, maternity HPL/ANC/delivery, dashboard stats). Playwright UI test confirmed login, nav, patient creation, drugs page (24 items), visits/billing/maternity/dashboard pages render, and logout works. Dashboard reflects all seeded data correctly (3 patients, 2 visits, Rp 36.500 revenue, 24 drugs).

minor.issue: Returns the generic message but response content equality verified; email sending not externally validated. Acceptable.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (a11y console warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription to all shadcn Dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 827-line file; could be split into routers (auth, patients, drugs, visits, invoices, maternity, dashboard) for maintainability.
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router; FastAPI applies middleware correctly either way, but convention is to add before mounting routers.
FRONTEND_URL fallback default in CORS allow_origins uses http://localhost:3000 — acceptable but violates the 'no defaults in .env usage' guideline.
calc_hpl Naegele implementation looks correct but has no unit tests; edge cases (Feb 29, month overflow after day adjust) could use targeted tests.
pay_invoice does not guard against double-payment (already Lunas); idempotent but still re-sets tanggal_bayar.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test patients (2x TEST_Siti Aminah, 1x UITEST Ibu <ts>), 2 visits with invoices (one paid, one unpaid), 1 completed pregnancy with ANC + delivery. Also test drug TEST_Obat was created and deleted during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist (configured in pytest.ini). All APIs under /api verified end-to-end. UI test confirms key data-testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit-button, nav-pasien, add-patient-button, form-nama, save-patient-button, logout-button. Logout button testid is 'logout-button' (not documented in request but present in Layout.jsx).
